Why Do Not Disturb Access is Needed
To instantly mute incoming calls, rings, and notifications so that your phone remains silent in your pocket or mugger\'s hands without alerting them.
Android requires a discreet foreground notification to keep the 15-minute emergency location updater alive in the background.

Protect financial wallets and private apps against coerced access.

Duress provides checklists, guides, and deep links to help you hide and isolate apps using your device\'s built-in secure vaults or Android Work Profiles. Duress does not and cannot uninstall other apps.
High-risk target during phone snatching. Funds can be drained in seconds without in-app protection.

1. Open Easypaisa -> My Account -> Biometric Verification / Fingerprint Login.
2. Enable Fingerprint/Face login.
3. Set a unique 5-digit PIN that differs completely from your phone unlock PIN.
4. Lower daily transfer limits in account settings.
5. Hide app inside your OEM vault (XHide / Secure Folder / Shelter).
Pakistan\'s most popular wallet. Requires biometric enforcement and MPIN secrecy.

1. Open JazzCash -> Settings -> Enable Biometric / Touch ID.
2. Choose a dedicated 4-digit MPIN never used on other platforms.
3. Always log out after completing transactions.
4. Never save your MPIN in WhatsApp or Notes.
5. Hide app inside OEM secure space.
Digital wallet and Mastercard. Features in-app card freeze for hostile situations.

1. Open SadaPay -> Security -> Enable Biometric login.\n2. When moving through high-risk streets, tap your Card and select \'Freeze Card\'.\n3. Keep your primary savings in SadaBiz or secondary vault, leaving minimal balance in wallet.
Fintech wallet with instant Visa debit card controls and transaction locks.
1. Open NayaPay -> Profile -> Security -> Enable Face/Fingerprint unlock.\n2. Set up a 6-digit MPIN.\n3. Lock international and online transactions when not actively using them.
Commercial Bank Apps (HBL, Meezan, MCB, UBL, etc.)
Holds major family savings. High coercion danger if attackers force you to unlock.

1. Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) inside bank settings.\n2. Never enable \'Remember Password\' or \'Auto-fill\'.\n3. Isolate commercial banking apps completely inside Second Space, Secure Folder, or Shelter work profile so they do not even appear in your phone\'s app list.
Prevents attackers from impersonating you or reading private sensitive messages.

1. WhatsApp -> Settings -> Account -> Two-step verification -> Turn on with 6-digit PIN.\n2. WhatsApp -> Settings -> Privacy -> App lock -> Unlock with fingerprint / face.\n3. Open any confidential chat -> Tap profile -> Chat lock -> Hide with secret code.
Photos of CNIC, passport, or family cards can be exploited for SIM issuance and identity theft.

1. In Google Photos, select photos of CNIC/Passports -> Move to \'Locked Folder\'.\n2. On Samsung/Infinix/Xiaomi/Vivo/Oppo, move photos into Private Safe / XHide / Secure Folder.\n3. Delete sensitive CNIC pictures from the regular camera roll and WhatsApp media.
Prevents thieves from moving your SIM to another phone to receive bank OTP SMS codes.

1. Open Settings -> Security -> SIM card lock.
2. Tap 'Lock SIM card'.
3. Enter default carrier PIN (Jazz/Telenor/Zong/Ufone default is typically 0000 or 1234).
4. Immediately tap 'Change SIM PIN' and set a personal 4-digit code.
WARNING: Do not enter wrong PIN more than 3 times without your SIM PUK code.
Thieves can read bank login OTPs directly on locked screens without unlocking.

1. Open Settings -> Notifications (or Display -> Lock screen).\n2. Select \'Sensitive notifications\' and set to \'Don\'t show\' or \'Hide content\'.\n3. Verify that receiving an SMS when locked only shows \'New message\' without revealing the text or verification code.
Simple patterns or 4-digit numbers like 0000 or 1234 are guessed instantly by snatchers.
1. Open Settings -> Security -> Screen lock.\n2. Switch from Pattern to \'PIN\' (at least 6 digits) or \'Password\'.\n3. Never use birth years, phone numbers, or repeated digits.
Infinix and Tecno phones feature built-in stealth vault \'XHide\' and app freezing to make apps completely invisible.

1. Open the 'Phone Master' app -> Tools -> XHide (or pinch out with 2 fingers on home screen).
2. Set a secret dialer code (e.g. ##1234).
3. Tap 'Hidden Apps' and add Easypaisa, JazzCash, or Banks.
4. Hidden apps disappear from launcher and search!
5. You can also use 'Freezer' to freeze unused apps so they run zero background activity.
Hardware-isolated Knox container that runs duplicate encrypted copies of financial apps with a separate password.

1. Go to Settings -> Security and privacy -> More security settings -> Secure Folder.
2. Sign in with Samsung account and create a separate PIN/Password.
3. Add banking apps inside Secure Folder.
4. In Secure Folder settings, toggle 'Hide Secure Folder icon from Apps screen'.
5. When hidden, it can only be unhidden via the Quick Settings tile or Settings.
Creates an entirely separate encrypted phone profile, or conceals apps behind a two-finger pinch gesture.

Method A (Second Space):
1. Settings -> Additional Settings -> Second Space.
2. Set a different unlock PIN/fingerprint.
3. Install bank apps only in Second Space. Snatchers in First Space see zero financial apps!

Method B (Hidden Apps):
1. Open 'Security' app -> App Lock -> Hidden Apps.
2. Select apps to hide. Pinch out with 2 fingers on home screen to view.
FuntouchOS allows encrypting and completely hiding app icons from the launcher and recent apps.

1. Settings -> Security -> Privacy and app encryption.
2. Set a privacy password.
3. Tap 'Hide App' and toggle banking apps.
4. Enable 'View hidden apps by swiping up with two fingers on the home screen'.
5. Enable 'Verify privacy password' before viewing.
ColorOS hides apps completely behind a secret dialer code (e.g. #0000#) typed in the phone keypad.

1. Settings -> Privacy -> Hide apps.
2. Set a privacy password.
3. Set an access code that starts and ends with # (e.g. #9876#).
4. Select banking apps. They will vanish from desktop, recent tasks, and notifications!
5. To access: Open Phone app and dial your access code.
Native Android 15 sandboxed space at the bottom of the app drawer with independent lock credentials.

1. Settings -> Security & privacy -> Private space.
2. Set up a separate lock screen PIN or fingerprint.
3. Install sensitive financial apps directly into Private Space.
4. Enable 'Hide private space when locked' so the section doesn't even appear in your app drawer until searched.
Universal open-source sandbox using Android\'s native Work Profile. Freezes sensitive apps and hides them with a single toggle.

1. Install 'Shelter' (from F-Droid or Play Store).
2. Follow setup to activate the Android Work Profile.
3. Clone Easypaisa, JazzCash, and banking apps into Shelter.
4. Uninstall the apps from your main personal profile.
5. Emergency Kill-Switch: Pull down Quick Settings and toggle 'Work Mode' OFF — all isolated apps instantly vanish and freeze!
Protect bank accounts, mobile wallets, and life savings from forced transfers during snatching or extortion.
Call immediately after escaping to block SIMs and freeze digital banking channels before attackers can transfer funds.
Cap digital transfer limits to minimal amounts across Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast, and Banks.

When attackers force victims to unlock their phone under duress, they immediately check balances and attempt to transfer the maximum daily limit (often Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 250,000). A pre-configured low limit stops the theft at the source.

1. Easypaisa / JazzCash: Open Account Settings -> Daily Limits -> set to the minimum practical amount (e.g. Rs. 5,000 - 10,000).
2. Banking Apps: Contact customer service or bank portal to reduce daily third-party funds transfer limit.
3. Raast: Lower Raast instant payment limits to avoid instant interbank draining.
4. ATM / POS: Set daily debit card POS limit to zero when not shopping.
Enforce 2–24 hour delays on adding new transfer recipients.

Snatchers transfer money to third-party mule accounts. If your bank requires adding a beneficiary with an enforced 2-hour or 24-hour cooling-off period before funds can move, attackers cannot transfer your money immediately.

1. In Bank Settings, disable 'Instant Quick Pay' to unadded payees if your bank allows it.
2. Keep only verified family members and utility billers as pre-approved beneficiaries.
3. Check your bank's cooling-off policy (Meezan, HBL, Standard Chartered enforce cooling-off by default).
4. If an attacker forces you to add a new account, the app will show 'Cannot transfer for 2 hours'.
Never keep life savings in checking accounts accessible on your daily mobile phone.

Liquid cash in checking accounts or mobile wallets is instantly transferable under coercion. Funds locked in fixed-term deposits or secondary savings accounts cannot be liquidated without multi-day branch approval or notice.

1. Two-Account Strategy: Use an everyday 'Street Account' with minimal balance (Rs. 3,000–5,000), and keep your primary wealth in a 'Vault Account' at a different bank.
2. Term Deposits (TDRs / Bachat Certificates): Lock savings in 3-month or 1-year terms. They cannot be transferred via mobile app.
3. Digital Vaults: Use SadaPay Vaults or JazzCash Bachat Committees where funds take 24 hours to mature before withdrawal.
4. Never install the banking app of your primary life-savings account on your street phone.
Cold Storage & Zero Crypto on Street Phone
Zero cryptocurrency hot wallets or exchange balances on everyday mobile devices.
Criminals actively look for Binance, OKX, Trust Wallet, or Telegram crypto bots. Because crypto transactions are completely irreversible, victims are held until entire balances are drained.

1. Offline Hardware Wallet: Store major crypto holdings on an air-gapped hardware wallet (Ledger, Trezor, Keystone, Tangem) stored securely at home.
2. Delete Hot Wallets: Never keep Trust Wallet, Metamask, or Binance on a phone you take outside.
3. Physical Seed Phrase Security: Never photograph or store your 12/24 seed words on Google Drive, Notes, or WhatsApp.
4. If trading is necessary, use a dedicated secondary device kept exclusively in a secure home location.
Android Find My Device & 15-Minute Emergency Window
Preparation for instant remote wipe and helpline blocking post-incident.
After escaping from muggers, there is a critical 15-minute window before they can crack your device. Remotely locking the device and immediately blocking the SIM stops OTP delivery.

1. Verify Find My Device is ON: Settings -> Google -> Find My Device -> toggle ON.
2. Remember Google Account login (email & password) to access android.com/find from any browser or friend's phone to erase or lock.
3. Post-Incident Priority 1: Call your telecom operator immediately from any bystander phone to block the SIM card (stops SMS OTPs).
4. Post-Incident Priority 2: Call Easypaisa/JazzCash and bank helplines to block mobile banking channels.
Ask representative to immediately block lost SIM to prevent OTP theft and unauthorized calls.
Request immediate temporary suspension of mobile wallet and linked debit cards.
Request immediate blocking of digital mobile app access, internet banking, and debit card.
Configure background persistence, accidental trigger guards, and privacy screen protections.
Prevents Android from putting Duress to sleep when the screen is locked, ensuring emergency key sequences are reliably detected.
Battery Optimization: Active (Risk of sleep delays)
Why Battery Optimization Exemption is Needed

Aggressive Android power managers (especially on Infinix, Tecno, Xiaomi, and Samsung) freeze background apps when the phone is locked. Exempting Duress ensures the volume button sequence responds instantaneously when you need it.
Vendor-specific steps and direct settings links to stop aggressive OEM task killers from freezing Duress.
Transsion devices aggressively kill background services via Power Master and Battery Lab.

1. Open Phone Master -> Auto-start management -> Enable Duress.\n2. In Recent Apps, swipe down on Duress to lock it with a padlock icon.\n3. Open Settings -> Battery Lab -> Disable \'Sleep Mode\' for Duress.
MIUI enforces strict background activity limits and aggressive RAM cleaning.
1. Settings -> Apps -> Permissions -> Autostart -> Allow Duress.\n2. Settings -> Battery -> Duress -> Select \'No restrictions\'.\n3. In Recent Apps, press and hold Duress card -> tap the Lock icon.
FuntouchOS throttles non-whitelisted apps when running in the background.
1. Settings -> Battery -> High background power consumption -> Allow Duress.\n2. Open iManager -> App Manager -> Autostart Manager -> Enable Duress.\n3. In Recent Apps, swipe down on Duress to lock.
ColorOS aggressively freezes background tasks and clears them on screen lock.
1. Settings -> Battery -> App Battery Management -> Duress -> Allow background activity.\n2. Enable \'Allow auto-launch\'.\n3. In Recent Apps, tap the 3 dots on Duress -> Lock.
One UI places inactive background apps into deep sleep.
1. Settings -> Battery -> Background usage limits -> Never sleeping apps -> Add Duress.\n2. Turn off \'Put unused apps to sleep\' if possible.
Ensure background data and power optimization are set to unrestricted.
1. Settings -> Apps -> Duress -> Battery -> Unrestricted.\n2. Mobile Data -> Allow background data usage.
Guards to prevent accidental triggers in pockets, bags, or during handling.
When key sequence is pressed, phone vibrates twice and waits before sending SOS. Pressing the opposite volume button immediately cancels the trigger.
Prevents screenshots, blocks screen recorders, and masks recent tasks thumbnails.
Shows a blank black preview in the Android app switcher so bystanders cannot see your Duress configuration.
Tap anywhere twice to exit camouflage mode.
